# Story 1.1: Add an item

Status: done

## Story

As a parent,
I want to add an item with its expiry date,
so that I know what I have (FR1).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Given the pantry list is open, when I add "Milk" expiring tomorrow, then "Milk" appears in the list with its expiry date.
2. Given the add form, when I leave the name empty, then I see "Name is required".
